provenance.l: New Glenn — Wikipedia (98 m, 7 m; GS1 7× BE-4, 19,928 kN, 340 s, ~190 s burn; GS2 2× BE-3U, 1,779 kN, 445 s, ~644 s burn; Blue Moon MK1 21,715 kg)
Blue Origin lists the BE-4 at 2,450 kN per engine: 7 × = 17,150 kN at liftoff; GS1 sea-level Isp derived from the SL/vacuum thrust ratio

Stage masses are not published: propellant derived from thrust × burn time / (Isp × g0) (GS1 ~1,135 t, GS2 ~262 t); dry masses and fairing mass estimated. Blue Moon MK1 is planned for 2027 and its own BE-7 makes the trans-lunar burn from low Earth orbit
